model.meaning: Logical fixed-record accounting; not a physical JavaScript heap bound

pendingSlot.rule: Install exact decoder state into original payload.scalar before reusing existing serialized pending slot. Retain original record/cell on the decoder state; no concurrent second decoder.

turns.rule: Require idle original receipt and exact bound original consumer. Check next u64 serial before mutation. Install prepared phase and serial in that original receipt.

Preflight65 before the intrinsic read: one byte of input copy plus64 fixed receipt-state bookkeeping. Copy one byte into the original preadmitted receipt, then mark read. Cursor/consumed stay unchanged; no returned byte object.
Only the original read receipt permits offset/consumed increment once. Set byte outcome and committed phase. No source read.
Decoder verifies private committed identity/serial, copies value into its one byte latch, and records the expected serial. No parse.
Preflight65 before mutation: consume one latched byte plus64 fixed scalar-state bookkeeping. Apply at most one byte, clear the latch and retain applied serial. No child call.
Original source checks the direct private applied-serial verifier, clears its byte outcome and returns receipt to idle. Serial is retained for observation/replay refusal.
Decoder observes exact original idle receipt with the same serial before another read/result publication.

sourceRules.profileSelection: Trusted exact parent at idle only; profile is a scalar algorithm, not authority for a whole native schema.
sourceRules.normalDecoderTurns: 7*b+3 scalar turns and450*b+192 logical work bytes including start/publish/consume; original child maintenance/admission/close are separate.

faultRules: Retain the first exact unknown thrown root before exposing rejection; do not stringify or replace it.
Same-value fault replay is inert; distinct fault stays caller-owned or is rethrown, not overwritten.
A caught after-read or after-parse mutation fault permanently quarantines forward work; close cannot mint a clean witness while fault remains.
Expected malformed-input diagnostics use a bounded enum and permit clean cancellation; arbitrary fault graphs have no implicit disposal.
No new facade or receipt on retry after registered construction/finalization failure.
Short-grant or refused admission preserves every original root and its charge.

validation.schema: Draft07 accepted iff expected is a nonempty string; rejected iff expected is null. Every primitive profile must occur.
validation.semantic: Vector and negative-case IDs must each be unique by exact string identity. This projection constraint is semantic validation, not a claim that JSON Schema uniqueItems enforces it.

mandatoryCallables: payload.beginReader(builder, consumer: OwnedUiScalarDecoder, receipt: OwnedUiScalarReadReceipt, grant)
readerTransaction.binding: Original payload.reader and payload.scalar plus its exact reader-admission slot mint the pair. Consumer and receipt are installed before reader finalization/exposure. All static matchers inspect private state directly and perform no callbacks.

readerTransaction.maintenance: A maintenance child turn forwards its original kind/items/bytes without receipt mutation or appended wrapper work. A separate64-byte original-state observation follows terminal child work. Unknown after-child mutation throws quarantine; no clean retry/rollback is inferred.
readerTransaction.cancellation: After decoder cancels/discards its latch, the same private witness permits source cancelScalar at64 bytes for original prepared/read/committed receipt. Uncommitted read leaves source cursor unchanged; committed read is not undone. No copied/parsed/EOF claim is minted.
readerTransaction.rawFault: First exact arbitrary exception is retained on the already charged original state/cell before rejection. A source-read after-return fault leaves receipt.value held and cursor unchanged. A commit after-return fault leaves cursor advanced once and forbids another commit.

machine.scope: Closed declaration model, not private-brand/runtime proof or scalar arithmetic implementation
machine.faultRule: Check exact identity and existing first fault before transition. Injected before fault changes only fault; after fault applies declared work then stores same first fault and rejects. Distinct second fault is returned as caller-owned without replacing first. The model tracks faultOwner=decoder while decoder credit remains, otherwise parent; the original proposed880-byte parent remains admitted and is never refunded by this child plan.
machine.shortGrant: Before any effect, maxItems >= items and maxBytes >= bytes; otherwise blocked with unchanged state and zero work.

closePlan.order: Original consumer detaches/settles before reader close. Reader capture precedes optional alias close; alias close precedes body proof. Page close is a separate later original-payload contribution, not a decoder-witness claim.
closePlan.parentFaultCustody: The original payload remains charged880 proposed bytes throughout child close. Its existing failure/pending fields retain an after-child-refund exception. Decoder992 refund never refunds that parent. A throw outside the canonical parent driver remains caller-owned until exact handoff; no discarded or converted fault.
closePlan.childAccounting: Fixture suffix sums count clean, granted close transitions only. Blocked/rejected children are forwarded and excluded from a finite completion claim. Current reader domain720 becomes proposed736 through separately priced pointer words; close work grants are unchanged because those words detach in the new consumer handshake.

constructionAliases.initial: Prefixes7..12 retain the same original state in payload.scalar and pending.entry. Prefix13 retains it in payload.scalar after normal pending-slot release; close capture recovers that state and its original cell/record/witness into the original slot before body clearing.
constructionAliases.capture: The separate64-byte capture turn checks the original payload frontier, copies the existing state.cell/state.record/witness into the existing seven-word pending slot, and installs the exact original state in pending.entry. It never selects a replacement by metadata or negative matching.
constructionAliases.clearBody: The272-byte fixed-state clearing turn requires original cell/record ownership already in the pending slot. It clears body and state-to-resource links only; payload.scalar and pending.entry remain original until the separate unlink turn.

unlink.atomicity: One bounded private turn verifies both pointers before clearing either. A63-byte/zero grant or foreign/ambiguous pointer changes nothing. After-return fault recovery uses the original pending phase/cell/record/witness, never a fabricated unlink success.

constructionAliases.recordRefund: The concrete typed owner refuses record retirement/refund while either state alias remains, while the exact unlinked frontier is absent, or while captured cell/record identities differ. Prefix7 has no constructed facade and uses the recorded never-installed frontier; prefixes8..13 require the original preadmitted witness and exact record-shell detach/observation.
constructionAliases.remainingOwners: After state unlink, the original pending slot still owns cell, record and, if constructed, the body-empty facade/witness. The neutral result/observation can retain only that emptied identity shell. Separate record close, resource-result unlink, cell close and parent observation retire those aliases. No state pointer, owner slot, record or witness is added.
constructionAliases.fullClose: The existing separately granted64-byte full-close unlink phase clears BOTH payload.scalar and pending.entry after body proof. The pending controller remains live through its existing cell/record/witness fields; its liveness flag is not a retained state alias. Full-close bytes and turns therefore remain unchanged.
constructionAliases.faults: Before/after every phase the first exact arbitrary fault root stays in the admitted original pending/cell or still-funded original payload. A fault after alias unlink preserves that observed frontier; a fault after child refund remains parent-held880. No forward retry, invented terminal witness, conversion or parent refund follows.
constructionAliases.prices: Construction prefixes7..13 add one64-byte work turn each, not resident capacity. Proposed decoder992, payload+8 and reader+16 remain unchanged.

registeredTestProposal.budget: Existing test-long budget; loops bounded by frozen vector/transition/prefix arrays, no arbitrary stutter multiplier.
registeredTestProposal.controller: Test-only pure validateScalarDeclarationCold + runScalarReceiptModelCold + runScalarCloseModelCold; strict Ajv then semantic ID/profile/value invariants, literal closed trace states and Immer parity.
registeredTestProposal.taxonomy: Before canonical leaf creation, coordinate retained/💾️resident/🔢️scalar schema/fixture domain and its generated launch seed with taxonomy owner. No ticket-path imports in permanent tests.
registeredTestProposal.launch: Canonical source-oracle release requires the taxonomy-owned seed and generated launch row for the existing Nx target with -t OwnedResidentScalar; no output-only launch row or separate task. Executed registration evidence belongs in the ticket, not this normative declaration.

phases: Prepare original cell in existing payload pending slot; recover its exact facade before claim.
Reserve the complete432-byte decoder domain record before any shell/state allocation.
Allocate32-word state, initialize exact original payload/cell/record ownership, then install the same state in BOTH original slot.entry and payload.scalar before any fallible constructor/finalizer.
Allocate scalar facade; install state.facade before original record.install and any freeze.
Allocate progress facade and install state.progress before its finalizer.
Allocate eight-word receipt with decoder identity and reader=null; install state.receipt before its finalizer.
Allocate original two-word scalar witness and install state.witness before its finalizer.
Finalize original shell; capture all record/cell/witness references on original state before releasing the reused pending slot.
Admit original reader through that same pending slot; its two proposed pointer words are reserved before reader state allocation.
During reader construction, install exact consumer/receipt association before finalization and before reader facade exposure.
Bind receipt.reader to that same reader in a separate64-byte source-owned turn, then observe private original binding64.
Publish scalar facade only after original reader/receipt pair is observed; no old optional advance path.

Construction cancellation first captures original resource authority, clears fixed body, obtains the existing preadmitted body proof when a facade exists, then separately unlinks BOTH state aliases64 before record retirement. Prefix13 reuses the original scalar state to recover the released slot; no new record or state.
constructionOrder.faults: At every listed finalizer, original parent holds state/shell/receipt already. Exact first fault remains in the existing parent failure or same original cell. Before reader admission, the explicit construction frontier proves never-bound; a negative matcher never supplies that fact. Body clearing never implicitly removes external aliases. An after-unlink failure retains the original slot phase/cell/record/witness; record refund refuses either held state alias.
